items.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $13 billion
items.note: Nvidia's second-biggest acquisition ever, folding the open-model hub into its AI stack; closes H1 2027

items.title: Gimlet Labs raises $300M for a multi-silicon inference cloud built for agentic AI
items.note: Series B at $3B valuation led by a16z, with Arm and Microsoft backing a chip-agnostic inference layer

items.title: Mortgage applications tick up as 30-year rate holds near 6.79%
items.note: Purchase index up 2% week-over-week even with rates near 13-month highs, per MBA's weekly survey

items.title: Anthropic walks away from its $6B deal to buy Israeli startup Decart
items.note: Would have been Anthropic's first Israel acquisition and largest ever; talks collapsed ahead of its expected IPO
